ex.note: For this exercise - Alternate between 2-3 reps of skull crushers and 2-3 reps of close grip bench. You can take brief pauses to catch breath. Ez curl or straight bar. Progress once both sets hit rep🎯

This set/rep scheme is an optional "bulldozer" set. 
To do it, perform the first set to 9-10RPE. Then perform each 'mini-set' after resting 10-30 seconds. You can sub with 2-4 regular sets instead
You can sub this with a bulldozer if you want. Try unilateral (one side only) and see if you like doing that more. You can swap between uni/bilateral between workouts if you want.
